mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_issue (coupon_id, user_no, use_yn, created_at) VALUES (#{couponId}, #{userNo}, #{useYn}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, i.user_no, IFNULL(i.use_yn, 'N') FROM coupon c LEFT OUTER JOIN coupon_issue i ON c.id = i.coupon_id and i.user_no = #{userNo} WHERE c.id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (id, discount_price, max_quantity, now_quantity, minimum_order_amount, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{discountPrice}, #{maxQuantity}, #{nowQuantity}, #{minimumOrderAmount}, NOW())
